title: TEDxWatford
summary: Hosted the first-ever TEDxWatford, and was part of the core organising team that brought it to life.

Over 300 guests gathered at Bhaktivedanta Manor for five hours of talks, storytelling, dinner and live music around the theme 'All You Need Is Love'. Nine speakers explored love through relationships, technology, health, sport, storytelling, family and spiritual practice.

title: LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group)
meta: Johannesburg office, joined virtually by colleagues across Africa and the Middle East · May 2025
summary: Interviewed S.B. Keshava Swami, a globally respected monk, author and speaker, on relationships, purpose, success and living with intention.
